name: sailor's canvas hammock slung between two hold posts, with a rolled red blanket inside

answer.evidence: The main body is a suspended canvas hammock, not an open frame or rack (there are no horizontal beams or base connecting the two hold posts, so kind_matches is false). Even if evaluated as a frame, it shows no top faces on any structural beams or base.

answer.main_body: canvas hammock slung between hold posts

The hammock is viewed from a 3/4 downward angle with a wide 6-row opening (rows 4-9) clearly revealing the interior canvas bed and the rolled blanket resting inside, bordered by a defined front rim at row 10 and the south-facing outer underbelly along rows 11-13.
